set.body: From the S10.5 keyboard journey (finding K1). Off macOS the window hides its menu bar, and 15 registry commands have no chord: Import sources…, Rename…, Reveal, Project info, Undo/Redo view change, Reset perspective, Appearance Light/Dark/System, Cancel run, Show the finished run, Review draft, Discard draft. On Linux and Windows these are reachable only where an in-window control happens to offer them. Decision (lead, 2026-10-05): show the in-window menu bar off macOS, with F10 and Alt mnemonics reaching it, the platform convention. Every registry command is then reachable by keyboard on every platform. Add a test that walks the registry and asserts a keyboard path for each command per platform.
set.title: Keyboard: every command reachable off macOS (show the menu bar, F10/Alt)
